nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_10
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the Target Location isn\'t placed on the floor then we add a sphere static mesh to the actor location so the path trace can collide with it, instead of the floor.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_14
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We can\'t use the same actor as reference or another platformer actor that is overlapping another one, so the reference will be deleted.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_22
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We remove instances located near the destination mesh, so they don\'t overlap.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_1
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: If the Actor Reference is valid and if it is another Platformer Actor then this one is placed at the corresponding box / sphere collision.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_2
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We draw a line trace to snap this actor to the floor. This actors world location is the end location of the predicted launch path.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_8
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we remove the instances of the predicted launch path that are inside the box collision. Just in case they overlap with the ring mesh.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_15
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We place the Arrow / Landing Location mesh at the end of the simulation trace or where it hits. This section is skipped if the Actor Reference is a valid Platformer Actor or if the mesh is not used.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_13
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This Tag index is used to save the rotation of the first path trace instance (or a custom rotation) so the animations can use the correct rotation while launching.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_7
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This Tag index is used to save the Ring world location.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_19
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we assign the Movement Input Behavior Name value.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_18
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This Tag index saves the height of the arc used by the predicted launch path.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_17
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we assign the Animation Type Name value.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_16
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This Tag index is used to save this Actors location.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_21
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we assign the Character Launch Position Name value.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_12
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: We place the box collision at the ring location and rotate it so it follows the predicted launch path or a custom rotation.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_11
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This section predicts the launch path using some user exposed parameters.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_23
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This Tag index is used to assign a name and identify Boost Ring Actors.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_5
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Here we select the mesh used at the end of the predicted launch path.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_20
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: The spline points location are set here. We do this to place the spline in the midpoint of the box collision.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_0
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This Actor can\'t be rotated. If rotated, the predicted launch path won\'t be accurate.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_9
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This Tag index is used to assign an unique ID to this Actor.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: This Tag index is used to identify an Actor that can interact with the Platformer Component.
